scripts.build: pnpm run build:types && pnpm run build:theme && pnpm run cem && pnpm -r run cem && pnpm run build:agent-docs
scripts.test:client: pnpm run build:types && vitest run --project client
scripts.test:components: pnpm run build:types && vitest run --project components
scripts.test:performance: pnpm run build:types && vitest run --config vitest.performance.config.ts
scripts.test:performance:primitives: pnpm run build:types && vitest run --config vitest.performance.config.ts packages/primitives
scripts.test:performance:api: pnpm run build:types && vitest run --config vitest.performance.config.ts packages/api-components
scripts.test:performance:production: pnpm run build:types && PERF_BUILD=production vitest run --config vitest.performance.config.ts
scripts.test:profile: pnpm run build:types && PERF_BUILD=production PERF_PROFILE=1 vitest run --config vitest.performance.config.ts
scripts.cem: pnpm run build:theme && cem generate && pnpm -r run cem
scripts.docs:check: pnpm run cem && pnpm -r run cem && (DRIFT="$(git status --porcelain -- .agents/skills/*/references packages/*/custom-elements.json)"; if [ -n "$DRIFT" ]; then echo 'Generated docs are stale — regenerate and commit the changes below:' >&2; echo "$DRIFT" >&2; exit 1; fi)
scripts.storybook: pnpm run build:types && pnpm run cem && storybook dev -p 6006
scripts.storybook:build: pnpm run build:types && pnpm run cem && storybook build
scripts.demo:sites: pnpm run sites:sync && (oxnode packages/demo/sites/announce-urls.ts &) && pnpm --filter "./packages/demo/sites/*" --parallel dev
